about: Round RPG11: which DawnLike sprite stands for whom on the map (assets/rpg/dawnlike/, CC-BY 4.0). The walker is one of DawnLike's commissioned class sheets: 4 rows (down, left, right, up; read in Warrior.png) of 4 walking frames. A foe kind is a 16 x 16 cell of a character sheet pair (<sheet>0.png and <sheet>1.png: DawnLike's 2-frame idle). Which cell for which kind is Claude's choice (23 Oct 2026), for Karl to change.
